serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Alright.
I should go home now and give that hobo some time to leave the area.
A long time has passed and it’s time to go home.
But man, I can’t believe there really was some evidence left. 
I know this isn’t much. I can only hope that it will bring peace to her family.
Maybe it’s just an excuse, maybe I’m doing this only to feel better about myself. The truth is I feel bad about running away, closing myself in my room and trying to forget all of it.
Whatever the reason, I should have done something about it a long time ago…
